messages:
sarah (AE): FYI Acme returned the POC orderform. Main asks: attach their PO PDF inside the DocuSign envelope and they added an HSM/KMS clause to the DPA. Also they want an 'Invoice Processing Code' on our invoice.

leo (SE): DocuSign can embed their PO as a document. Make sure documentId ordering has PO first. Avoid signerAttachment; use documents[]. Also watch composite templates.

ops-bot: DocuSign tip: include supportingDocument or explicit documents array to ensure attachments are preserved across templates.

anna (Legal): We cannot promise tenant-level HSM on hosted. Proposed language: "Hosted: cloud KMS integration available. Private deployment: HSM-backed keys available under separate SOW." I'll draft an appendix that clarifies options.

karim (Finance): Need their remit address, tax ID, exact invoice processing code field name, and payment terms on the PO. Can't create invoice without tax ID and terms.

sarah (AE): I'll ask Acme to confirm doc order (PO first), share the exact PO PDF, and confirm whether exec sign needed above $50k.

leo (SE): I'll prepare a simple envelope payload example for eng and a small test that outputs the merged PDF so we can verify the PO sits at the top.

anna (Legal): Also recommend adding acceptance language to the orderform: "A Purchase Order referencing the MSA and signed by Customer and Redwood (electronic acceptance) constitutes a binding order."

karim (Finance): If they insist PO-in-envelope, confirm where to put the invoice processing code (memo vs line item). Our AR mapping depends on that.

sarah (AE): Action items: 1) me -> Acme for PO PDF + billing fields + doc order; 2) Anna -> DPA appendix + one-line order acceptance redline; 3) Leo -> envelope example & test. Will reconvene after Acme replies.

ops-bot: Reminder: set documentVisibility if any internal docs should be hidden.

sarah (AE): Thanks all — I'll send Acme a consolidated reply.
